description: This file contains the implementation of an Android activity that visualizes a 3D Rubik's Cube using OpenGL ES. It includes setup for 3D objects, layers, permutation logic for cube rotations, and animation callbacks for cube manipulations.

classes.name: Kube
classes.description: Main activity managing the 3D Rubik's Cube visualization and animation.

methods.name: makeGLWorld
methods.description: Constructs and initializes the 3D world with cube shapes and colors.

methods.name: createLayers
methods.description: Initializes the cube's layers for rotation.

methods.name: updateLayers
methods.description: Updates shape references within each layer based on the current permutation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Android activity lifecycle method for initial setup.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes rendering when the activity is resumed.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses rendering when the activity is paused.

methods.name: animate
methods.description: Handles cube layer rotation animations and permutation updates.
